title: Six Winters and One Short Line
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：fault　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fault 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my father ① found a fault that no engineer in the yard would have named, and he said the finding was the whole of the winter. The ② fault, meaning the flaw itself and not the blame, ran six winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a fault, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fault in that yard had the same short line beside it, and the ④ fault at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the bridge and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fault, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my father said the naming is the part that fills six winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the fault was the whole of the matter, meaning the blame and not the flaw. The ⑥ fault, meaning the blame and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fault, she said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a flaw and blame. She said the blame is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ fault had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ fault of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one yard and six winters of naming; fault, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fault I remember is the one named in the report, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ fault, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being named; every fault, she said, is blame that has agreed to look like a flaw. She said the blame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 缺点；毛病（指场院里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 缺陷（指那一处本身，与责备相对）
C. 固定搭配：find a fault 找出一处缺陷
D. n. 缺陷（指留给大桥的那一处）
E. n. 缺陷（抽象总称，指一处场院的毛病之事）
F. n. 缺陷（指报告上写到、被说出的那一处）
G. n. 过错；责任（指一件事里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 责任（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）

items.q: found a fault that no engineer in the yard would have named
The fault, meaning the flaw itself and not the blame
the fault at the far side
the fault was the whole of the matter
the fault had become a line in a report
The fault of the whole thing
A fault, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: find a fault 意为“找出一处缺陷”，1964 年父亲找出了一处场院里没有一位工程师肯说出的缺陷。
fault 意为“缺陷”，指那一处本身而不是责备，它经过了六个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
fault 意为“缺点、毛病”，指场院里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一行短短的字。
fault 意为“缺陷”，指留给大桥的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fault 意为“过错、责任”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西，姑姑说这份责任就是那件事的全部。
fault 意为“责任”，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西而不是那一处缺陷，是事情里人人都等、却无人说出的东西。
fault 意为“缺陷”，指报告上写到、被说出的那一处，到 1970 年这一处成了报告里的一行。
fault 意为“缺陷”，父亲一月写道，整件事的毛病之处是一处场院和六个冬天的说出。
fault 意为“缺陷”，我记得的是报告上说出的那一处，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成场院里最安静的一处。
fault 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一处缺陷是唯一会因为被好好说出而变得更好的东西。
